info.headline: Flood Warning for Bunyip River, Bunyip River at Iona and Bunyip River at Cora Lynn
info.description:
Flooding is no longer expected across the Bunyip River catchment.
The Bunyip River at Iona peaked at 1.69 m around 10:45 pm Saturday, below the minor flood level. The river is currently at 1.52 m and falling slowly. The Bunyip River at Iona is expected to remain below the minor flood level (2.10 m).
The Bunyip River at Cora Lynn peaked at 3.09 m around 12:45 am Sunday, just below the minor flood level. The river is currently at 2.91 m and falling. The Bunyip River at Cora Lynn is expected to remain below the minor flood level (3.10 m).
info.instruction:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous. * Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways. * Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads. * Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay informed. * For local emergency management warnings and advice visit www.emergency.vic.gov.au.
For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.
